nom: Doré La Micellaire Botanical Micellar Cleansing Water

avis.texte: I LOVE this micellar water. It removes all of my makeup, and is the perfect precleanse before going in with an actual face wash. I have very sensitive and acne prone skin. This doesn't break me out at all.
Very gentle. Doesn't upset my very sensitive skin at all. No breakouts & no redness.
This "micellar" water does not remove makeup no matter how hard you try. I always have to double back with my garnier to actually feel clean. Does not remove eye makeup or foundation.

I got this as a free sample, and so glad I did. It is gentle and moisturizing on my dry, sensitive skin. I do need to use a separate product to remove waterproof mascara. But wouldn't expect a gentle cleansing water to be able to take off tough waterproof mascara. Not even the micellar waters that say they can remove, work on my waterproof mascara. I don't understand any negative reviews on this product.
I have super sensitive skin and this makes my skin feel so good. It doesnt irritate or dry out my skin either. I recommend this over any of micellar water!

The back of the bottle specifically says it is made to remove makeup, but it doesn't. Every time I use it I just have wet smeared makeup all over my face. Thankfully it was on sale or I'd be very upset. I'll stick to my Garnier micellar water!

avis.titre: Will not take off your makeup
avis.texte: The packaging of this product and the fact that it was on sale made me give it a try, but this is the worst micellar water I've used! Definitely use a drugstore one like the Garnier Fructis instead and save your money.
its very gentle and nice on the skin. I do my daily face wash routine and use this after on a cotton pad and it removes whatever makeup my cleansers didnt get off.

Most of the bad reviews here talk about the fact that it doesnt remove makeup well but it isnt for that. It cleanses the skin gently. The founder made it because tap water makes her break out. Love this for a gentle morning cleanse.
This does nothing to help properly remove makeup even if rubbing harshly. Not worth the money spent on it even when bought on sale. Drug store brands work much better than this.

This micellar water is what got my fungal acne to FINALLY clear up! After a year of relentless, horrible pimples on my temples and forehead, and wasting SOOOOOO much money on products thaf only made it worse. I found this, completely stripped my routine down to this, zinc soap bar, and a basic moisturizer, and my skin looks and feels the best it has in years!

This does not work to remove makeup and it also is not gentle. I am trying to come up with a different way to use it so that I am not completely throwing my hard earned money away, needless to say I do not recommend this product.
Leaves a film feeling. Used it with my reusable make up removing pads and I had to rub harder than I usually do with my cheaper micellaire water.
This is the worst micellar water i have ever used. I appreciate it being advertised as being natural and gentle but it is no better than using regular water on my face.
I got this as a sample, and waa excited to try it. Love the packaging, but I found out it doesnt remove eye makeup very well. It smears it around, and burned my eyes.

this Dore micellar water caused me chemical burn, severe irritation that lasted for days and it completely dried my skin out. I have never had a product cause that dryness to my face. I have had to moisturize several times a day to restore my skin.

avis.titre: Not similar to garnier micellar water
avis.texte: I didnt find this removed makeup or cleansed at all. Thought it looked a little more elevated than my usual garnier micellar, but this is similar to washing your face with just water. Doesnt feel like any of my sunscreen or makeup came off

avis.titre: So happy I bought this on clearance
avis.texte: Garnier's the micellar water you can trust at 2am with raccoon eyes and regrets. Doré? She's the girl who flakes on plans and charges extra for nothing. 🧼💅 I went though 6 cotton rounds to remove a full face while my drugstore micellar water can get the job done with two.
Love the clean ingredients, but unfortunately this doesn't remove makeup, definitely not mascara. Has the effectiveness of tap water. Won't be buying again :(

It's a gentle micellar water that doesn't irritate and isn't sticky. However, it isn't great at taking off eye makeup, even regular mascara or eyeliner. I've had to use other makeup remover to take off remaining mascara. The bottle is beautiful.
DOES NOT DISAPPOINT!! So many Micellar waters seemed to strip and dry out my skin but this one cleans and removes my makeup while still leaving it hydrated.

I bought this because I wanted a clean micellar water. I was excited to try but quickly realized it doesn't clean as well as my bioderma. I did a side by side test and the results spoke for themselves. Sadly I returned

I like this! It takes off foundation really well. Also takes off mascara and liner, just takes a few more passes to get all of the mascara (regular, I don't know about waterproof). I usually purchase Bioderma, but it's getting harder to find, so I thought I'd try this. It's a good replacement.

The reason for the 4 star review, is it doesn really take off mascara at all. it feels great on the skin. Its lightly scented. The reason I tried this,I met the co owner at Ulta beauty in Garden city. She was very enthusiastic and proud of her products. she took the time to explain a little bit about her line. I will give her other products a try. it does take off foundation makeup, and leaves my skin feeling refreshed. I'd say if your skeptical, try the trial size.
Save ur money and use garnier micellar water. This cause my whole skin to turn lobster red and get a skin burn

I have been using this product for the past week and im in LOVE! Ive been seeing a drastic change with my skin as it has been getting more clear. removes makeup gently and thoroughly and leaves my skin so soft. get it!

avis.titre: This product has become a staple in my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I love cleaning my skin with this micellar water. It's gentle, yet very effective. I also love that it doesn't dry out my skin, which many cleansers do. The packaging is gorgeous and it's a standout on my vanity. And you can't beat the price. Highly, highly recommend!
